about: The balcony door at the start of the balcony beat: it slides open along the inside of the wall by the doorway's width, then stands open. Played once from the stage's start; the scene record already stands the leaf open (its `moved`), so the slide starts 1.4 m back, shut. No sound plays with it. The flat's front door is an open doorway and never moves. Frame: the flat's, 9 m up (data/scene/flat.json).

motions.name: balcony_door
motions.from: the slide the balcony doorway's width, 1.4 m (data/plans/flat.json doors: BALCONY DOOR (glass) 1.4 x 2.2 m); at 0.3048 m/s, 12 in. a second, the most a door that opens near people may move: ANSI/BHMA A156.38 (low energy power operated sliding doors) opens at 12 in./s at most, https://buildershardware.com/LinkClick.aspx?fileticket=RzVEAlFx4X4%3D&portalid=0, and ANSI/BHMA A156.10 closes a sliding leaf of up to 160 lb at 1 ft/s at most, https://www.automateddoorsolutions.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/08/ANSI-A156-10-2005.pdf; so 4.59 s
